HSFC.description: Heat Source Function (HSFC). The TYPE field selects which fields apply: CONST uses TEMP_CONST; FUNC uses OPT_USE_CONC_DATA to switch between (K, ALPHA) and (CEMENT_TYPE, TEMP_FUNC, CEMENT_CONT); USER uses IS_ADIABATIC_TEMP, SCALE_FACTOR and the ITEM time-value function data.

TYPE.description: Heat source function type (case-insensitive). CONST = constant heat source; FUNC = code-based adiabatic temperature rise function; USER = user-defined function data.

OPT_USE_CONC_DATA.description: [TYPE=FUNC] Whether to use concrete data. false = specify K and ALPHA directly; true = specify CEMENT_TYPE, TEMP_FUNC and CEMENT_CONT.

CEMENT_TYPE.description: [TYPE=FUNC, OPT_USE_CONC_DATA=true] Cement type code. 0 = Normal Portland Cement; 1 = Moderate Heat Portland Cement; 2 = High-early-strength Portland Cement; 3 = Blast-furnace Slag Cement; 4 = Fly Ash Cement.

TEMP_FUNC.description: [TYPE=FUNC, OPT_USE_CONC_DATA=true] Temperature code. 0 = 10 deg; 1 = 20 deg; 2 = 30 deg.

IS_ADIABATIC_TEMP.description: [TYPE=USER] Data type flag. true = data values are Temperature (adiabatic temperature); false = data values are Heat Source.

SCALE_FACTOR.description: [TYPE=USER] Scale factor applied to the function data.

ITEM.description: [TYPE=USER] Function data table (time-value pairs). Must contain at least one entry when TYPE=USER.

VALUE.description: Value at the given time (heat source or temperature depending on IS_ADIABATIC_TEMP).
